source_role: Official British Museum catalogue and image metadata for exact-source audit.
title: Gold signet-ring of Sheshonq

construction.bezel_back: The bezel is so thick that its back was cut away to accommodate the wearer's finger.
construction.assembly: The shank and bezel were made in separate moulds and joined together.

inscription.identity: Name of Sheshonq and title 'Chief Steward of the divine adoratrice'.
inscription.function: The bezel could be pressed into mud to seal documents and objects.

official_views.role: Primary full-object three-quarter face view: complete hoop, shoulders, thick lozenge bezel, and defining inscription.
Alternate full-object face view on dark ground; corroborates silhouette and proportions.
Oblique side/underside view: hoop opening, thick bezel depth, shoulders, and finger-accommodation cutaway.
